notes.title: Survival Minigame Added!
notes.content:
[h1]How many rounds can you survive in the new Survival Game-Mode?[/h1]

[h3]Click the Survival button in the main menu to start playing.[/h3]


Survive as many rounds as you can in the new survival mini-game, are you struggling in the campaign? you can now grind potions in the Survival Minigame, and take them with you to the campaign, please note this only works if you dont restart the game in the meantime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44151217/ed8a269f0f4665838b2c6971dd8a0be5c7019c5e.png[/img]

notes.title: Small game patch dropped.
notes.content:
[h2]Player will now stop walking instantly when no input is detected, this will make platforming easier.[/h2]

[h2]The player's damage range has been extended, you can now hit enemies while standing a little further away.[/h2]

[h3]25 other / smaller bugs have been fixed aswell.[/h3]

[url=https://deadeagle.nl/]DeadEagle.nl[/url]
